state.background: Review the corrected current implementation checkpoint for P42-189/P42-190. In the dark-mode/text-zoom mobile E2E test, the previous `tooltip.locator(":scope > div").nth(1)` could target the total row when showTotal is enabled. The corrected code defines one locator `categoryRow = tooltip.locator('[data-tooltip-row="true"]').first()` and uses it for both P42-189 visibility and P42-190 nonempty text. P42-190 replaces a weak regex accepting any of three hard-coded labels with a non-whitespace check on the actual selected chart's first category row. Do not claim that unit tests establish selected-chart-to-category mapping: the ledger explicitly says they cover generic payload content only. Browser test still checks tooltip visible after a real mobile tap, close button visible, the actual category row visible/nonempty, a digit is present, and close hides the tooltip; the other P42-191 numeric/dark-mode/zoom/tap/close behavior remains. The false-target locator attempt was audited and corrected; only the final corrected test run is evidence. Ledger rows P42-189 and P42-190 map the exact source assertions and this boundary. No production/OpenSpec changes.
acceptanceCriteria: Both P42-189 and P42-190 target the same actual category row identified by `[data-tooltip-row="true"]`, not a generic child div that could select the total row.
P42-189 checks that the category row is browser-visible after actual mobile tap and tooltip visibility.
P42-190 checks that the selected chart's actual category row has nonempty text without pretending a generic regex proves the exact chart/category mapping.

The browser assertions for tooltip visibility, close button, numeric digit, close click/hide, theme and text zoom remain. Unit tests may support generic tooltip row rendering but are not treated as proof of selected-chart mapping.
The ledger mapping agrees with the corrected source lines: 176 visibility (P42-189), 177 nonempty text (P42-190), 178 digit (P42-191), 180 close/hide (P42-192).

Final verification passes: CustomTooltip Vitest 32/32, exit 0; corrected mobile-pixel acceptance E2E 6 passed, 0 failed/skipped, exit 0. The earlier false-target run is explicitly superseded and excluded as passing evidence.
